originating_prompt:
Follow-up fixes for the Surzion storefront after reviewing the published site in the browser. Do not ask clarifying questions — make sensible choices and list them at the end. Delegate page work to the smart-page-designer, transaction changes to the transaction-designer, and run the smart-page-reviewer at the end.

1. Broken "BY KAPSONS" image on the home hero. `kapsons_by_logo.png` was written into Page_Design/assets by hand, so the published site refuses to serve it (only library content-hash names are served; page_verify reports `asset_not_library_named`). Re-import the picture properly with `app_api.py import-image "https://assets.zyrosite.com/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,w=1440,h=317,fit=crop/dJoPq545ePc4y7po/untitled-design-3-wPHYU0kKxks4USI9.png"`, point every reference to the URL it returns, then delete the hand-written file and its index.json entry. Check the Surzion logo image the same way.

2. Hero look: the Surzion logo PNG has a white background that shows as a white box on the darker photo. Match the reference (logo on a light background): keep the parallax image but make its overlay light enough (white, ~85-90%) that the logo's white blends in, and keep the subtitle and buttons readable.

3. Reviews — verified purchase and date:
   - Add a column VERIFIED (CHAR(1), Y/N, default N, protected) to surz_product_review (Database_Design + deploy).
   - On every product page's reviews block set `columns.verified: "VERIFIED"`, `verifiedValue: "Y"` and `columns.date: "ADD_DATE"` so the "Verified purchase" badge and the review date show.

4. Mobile sign-in: set `application.auth.defaultCountryCode` to "+91" so Indian customers can type a 10-digit mobile number at checkout without the country code.

5. Header: the announcement bar and the header band are boxed (they stop at the content width). Make both bands full width (full-bleed background) while keeping their content aligned to the page's content width.

6. Footer:
   - The enquiry form's heading ("We'll reply within 12 hours") is dark text on the dark footer — make it light and readable.
   - Add clear spacing between the left-column groups (tagline, Contact us, Follow us, Policies and company).
   - The bottom row's policy links render as default blue underlined links; style them like the rest of the footer (light, no underline until hover) and don't duplicate links that the Policies group already shows — keep the bottom row to the copyright plus at most a short legal line.

7. Partner portal: every per-account embed on the partner portal page should use `signInPrompt` with title "Sign in to your partner account" and a body explaining that partners see their application, discount code and referred orders after signing in (register link: "Create an account").

Verify every changed page (page_verify must show no errors) and summarise each change.

## VERDICT: **PASS** ✓

All five smart pages are correctly wired. No errors found. All image URLs resolve to library-named assets, all embeds have required signInPrompt configurations, all reviews column mappings match the database schema, and all styling/color configurations are consistent.All seven fixes are in. I couldn't run `page_verify` here, so the substitute checks were: all page files parse, every image URL resolves to a library asset, and the smart-page reviewer passed the changed pages. I haven't looked at any page rendered, so please open the home page, header, footer and partner portal in the workbench.

1. **BY KAPSONS image:** I re-imported it with `app_api.py import-image` and it came back as `a7d69abbe446cb09.png`. `model_surz_home.json` now points at that file. The hand-written `kapsons_by_logo.png` and its `index.json` entry are deleted. The Surzion logo (`77fd5cd73669e05e.jpg`) already has a library name, so I left it.
2. **Hero:** The parallax image stays, with the overlay set to white at 0.88 so the logo's white blends in. The title and buttons were already dark text on a light background, so I left them.
3. **Reviews:**
   - `VERIFIED` is a 1-character Y/N column, default N, protected, in `model_surz_product_review.json` and `Database_Design/SURZ_PRODUCT_REVIEW.json`. I made it `VARCHAR1` rather than `CHAR(1)`, because the model rules say new string columns shouldn't be `CHAR`. The unit test passes and the column is in the live table.
   - All 22 `surz_p_*` pages have `columns.verified: "VERIFIED"`, `verifiedValue: "Y"` and `columns.date: "ADD_DATE"` on their reviews block.
4. **Mobile sign-in:** `application.auth.defaultCountryCode` is `+91` in `application.json`.
5. **Header (`model_surz_site_header.json`):** The announcement bar is now its own full-width blue section. The header band is a full-width white section, and both keep their content at page width.
6. **Footer (`model_surz_site_footer.json`):**
   - The enquiry heading and the left-column group headings are white.
   - The groups have extra top spacing.
   - The duplicate policy buttons are gone from the bottom row. It now has the copyright line plus "Surzion is a brand of Kapsons." in light grey.
7. **Partner portal (`model_surz_partner_portal.json`):** Both embeds use the sign-in prompt "Sign in to your partner account". Its body explains that partners see their application, discount code and referred orders after signing in, and the register link says "Create an account".

Things to check in the preview:
- **Announcement bar:** It sits in a section tagged `custom`, because the header tag is a singleton. If the site only renders `header`-tagged sections as chrome, the bar won't appear and the tag needs changing. The reviewer didn't resolve this.
- **Footer form:** The form's text colour is set to white, but there is no separate setting for its field labels and helper text, so check those on the dark background.
- **Legal line:** I wrote "Surzion is a brand of Kapsons." myself, based on the logo.
- **VERIFIED flag:** The storefront reviews block has to set it to Y from its purchase check. I haven't tested that.
